notes.title: Update 1.4.2501
notes.notes:
[h2]Update 1.4.2501[/h2]
This update includes tons of enhancements to energy weapons, as well as a broad set of improvements and fixes based on your feedback. Thank you to everyone that shared your thoughts with us! We look forward to hearing what you think about these changes.

[h3]AI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Decreased how much enemies prioritize their initial target. Increased how much enemies prioritize potential targets that recently caused damage. This change will make it easier to manage mixed groups of enemies. For example, now players can drag creature patrols onto an android outpost, and vice versa.
[*] Enemies will now be a little less aggressive when chasing.
[/list]
[h3]AUDIO[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated audio volume behavior so that lower volume values will now be much quieter.
[*] Changed Audio Settings Master Volume default value from 100% to 75%.
[*] Decreased the volume of the starting video by about 20%.
[*] Enemy base turret explosions will now be a little quieter.
[/list]
[h3]COMBAT[/h3]
[list]
[*] Total overhaul of laser weapons and lightning weapons. All new SFX for almost every weapon, including new muzzle flares, impact particles, and unique sounds - weapons should look and feel much more distinct. Several laser weapons were also converted from a laser beam (or ray) that instantly hits the target to a new laser bolt (or ray march) that moves through space towards the target.
[*] Increased the health and damage of Laser Turrets, Flame Turrets, and Tesla Turrets by about 35%.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the player to not receive loot/XP for a kill when the player's turret caused the killing shot.
[*] The player's deployable turrets now have identical perception ranges in combat and out of combat. This should make turrets behave more consistently.
[/list]
[h3]CRAFTING[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the descriptions for various items and schematics to make their benefits and mode of operation more clear. This affects all of the Shield Generators, Cybernetic Implants, Med Kits, Plasma Pick, Mining Drill, and Drill Bot.
[*] The Drill Bot schematic will now create 4 Drill Bots instead of 1. This should make the cost more inline with the benefit.
[/list]
[h3]MISSIONS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor updates to mission text to improve clarity.
[/list]
[h3]PUZZLES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the difficulty of the Timed Target puzzle. Decreased the initial speed that the light moves around the target. Decreased how much the light speeds up with each piston locked. This should make the puzzle much more approachable for most players. As always, we welcome player feedback on this and all of our changes. We are planning to add settings to adjust the difficulty of puzzles in a future update.
[/list]
[h3]SETTINGS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed Audio Settings Master Volume default value from 100% to 75%.
[/list]
[h3]SHIP[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added additional SFX to the drop pod! New engine particles, dust, smoke, and turbulence.
[/list]
[h3]MISC[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new images and icons for various items and schematics.
[*] Almost all interaction timers have been reduced by 25-50%.
[*] Interact actions can now be chained by holding the Interact hotkey. For example, players can now gather multiple collectables without needing to press and release the Interact hotkey for each one.
[*] Updated the day night cycles of each of the biomes to prevent shadows from being cast through the ground around dawn/dusk.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3.2411
notes.notes:
[h2]Update 1.3.2411[/h2]
This update includes a broad set of improvements and fixes based on your feedback. Thank you to everyone that shared your thoughts with us!

[h3]AI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ranged enemies will now move significantly more in combat. They will occasionally move behind cover. In larger groups, some may move to flank their target.
[*] When several melee enemies are attacking the same target, they will now spread out more around their target.
[*] Enemies will now try to maintain a minimum distance from their target, and will move backwards when their target gets too close. This will make it easier to shoot melee enemies that were getting too close to the player.
[*] Ranged enemies will now perform dodging behaviors when attacked.
[*] Updated the movement properties and colliders for some creatures to prevent them from walking on top of each other.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused AIs to think they had line of sight on their target, when the target moved out of their perception range very quickly.
[/list]
[h3]COMBAT[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased the base accuracy of some projectile weapons to improve their effectiveness against moving enemies.
[/list]
[h3]CRAFTING[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that resulted in some automated schematics continuing to output items after all fuel was consumed.
[/list]
[h3]MISSIONS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the objective text for the "Secure Data" mission to indicate that the required items are obtained from chests.
[/list]
[h3]PUZZLES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the speed of the Timed Target puzzle by about 25%.
[/list]
[h3]RESEARCH[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Flame Turret to unlock at research level 3 instead of research level 2.
[/list]
[h3]SETTINGS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where settings may not have been saved if the game was immediately exited after changing settings.
[/list]
[h3]SHIP[/h3]
[list]
[*] The compass marker for the drop pod will now mark the bridge console, hangar console, or drop pod, depending on which of those three is interactable. This should make it more clear that players must warp at the bridge console before using the drop pod to visit a new island.
[*] Added additional signs throughout the ship to help the player navigate. These signs include markers for the bridge, hangar, engine room, etc.
[/list]
[h3]STARTING EXPERIENCE[/h3]
[list]
[*] The number of enemies in large camps has been significantly reduced at lower levels, and will now increase over the first 15 levels. This includes both enemies patrolling inside of a large camp, and the number of enemy reinforcements that arrive when a large camp is attacked.
[/list]
[h3]MISC[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the default hotkey for turning on/off the Flashlight from X to F.
[*] Updated the default hotkey for opening the player's inventory UI I to Tab.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where closing an inventory could result in input not responding.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some achievements not to unlock as a result of defeated enemies being counted incorrectly. The supporting statistics are corrected retroactively when a saved game is loaded. [*] If an achievement should have been unlocked for a save, an unlock will be triggered when that saved game is loaded.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.2409
notes.notes:
[h2]Update 1.2.2409[/h2]
We’ve made a number of changes to the early game experience based on feedback. Thank you to everyone who has shared their thoughts and helped us make Far Horizon a better experience for it!

[h3]STARTING EXPERIENCE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the iron ingots required to craft drop pod repair parts from 4 to 3. This reduces the amount of required raw iron from 24 to 18.
[*] If a player on the mission "We Require More Minerals" hasn't located enough iron ore for several minutes, Zeus will grant assistance by marking all iron ore nodes on the compass.
[*] Large enemy encampments will no longer appear on the first island, to give players more time to get adjusted to combat.
[*] The size of the first island has been reduced by 50%.
[*] Several early mission descriptions have been updated to improve clarity.
[*] The location of the research data cache in the mission "Away" has been adjusted to prevent large groups of hostile animals spawning nearby.
[/list]
[h3]MISSIONS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mission items required for the "Secure Data" and "Combat Protocols" missions will now be easier to find.
[*] A new mission has been added after "The Circle of Life" to analyze Horticulture Data Chips after collecting them.
[/list]
[h3]CRAFTING[/h3]
[list]
[*] Supercharged Shield Generator schematics now require Rutilant Cloth instead of Rutilant Weave.
[/list]
[h3]MISC[/h3]
[list]
[*] If the Plasma Pick or Mining Drill are crafted after warping to an island, they can now be used right away, and no longer require warping to a new island before becoming usable.
[*] Added additional colliders to the Engine Room to prevent players getting stuck if they climb on the generators.
[/list]
